{{Top|leg}}
A '''tattooist''', or '''tattoo artist''', was a person who drew [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]] on people's skin as a job. Notable examples were [[Bojam Rees]], who made a living as a tattooist on [[Starstation 12]] and the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lafrarian]] [[Nuyu]], a tattoo [[Artist/Legends|artist]] and body decorator who ran a small shop on [[StarForge Station]]. The [[Blue Sector/Legends|Blue Sector]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]] hosted a high proportion of tattoo parlors.
